thread:
liz_w: quick run through for the "Sparrow" observability panel. need tight GA slice to satisfy pilots without adding infra risk.

maria_k: customer themes: single-pane cost by route, visible error hotspots, jump-to-trace when available, and a way to mute noisy endpoints (sampling). also minimal alert hook.

samir: constraints: full trace capture is expensive. recommend a jump-to-trace (trace_id lookup) + sampling presets. must verify trace_id flows for legacy ingestion or show "trace unavailable".
jordan_p: can we agree acceptance now? i'll size APIs after.
emily: suggested GA acceptance: 1) Route cost row (7d sparkline) 2) Error hotspot tile with top-10 endpoints 3) "Open trace" action that deep-links if trace exists (otherwise shows status) 4) Sampling presets UI (low/medium/high) 5) PagerDuty webhook MVP 6) Retention UI default 7d and enterprise opt-in.
maria_k: add rollout: 5 pilot orgs for 48h, expand to 50 if stable. gate: median token latency delta <3% and trace-forwarder error rate <5%.
samir: infra notes: add sampling flag to routing policy, ensure serializer preserves trace_id, add circuit-breaker for trace-forwarder and emit per-route KV hit metrics. sampling mustn't invalidate KV caches.
jordan_p: ballpark dev: visibility slice (cost row + hotspot + trace-link + presets) =~ 3 dev-weeks; PD hook + retention UI =~ 1 week; 30d retention or full capture = +2 wks.
liz_w: decision: ship GA with visibility must-haves, default 7d, gate 30d behind enterprise, use presets. owners: emily (mock), samir (infra), jordan (API), maria (comms).
emily: i'll post a compact mock with copy by EOD.
opsbot: deploybot: feature gate created: feature=sparrow-panel-v1, env=staging, owners=[samir,jordan_p]

liz_w: thanks all 1f680  reconvene in 48h after mocks + infra doc. ping me for blockers.
